style_prefix: Popular YouTube-style simple 2D stickman history explainer illustration; bold clean dark outlines, round simple heads, thin line limbs, compact flat-color bodies, expressive readable poses; no photorealism, no 3D, no live action.
character_look: The same main stickman in every scene: a small cream-colored round head with two dot eyes, one simple expressive black mouth, thin black line arms and legs, a short charcoal tunic with a muted rust-red belt, and consistent simple proportions; flat 2D ink outline, no realistic anatomy.
color_palette: Parchment cream, charcoal black, muted rust orange, dusty olive, and warm stone gray; flat colors with strong contrast.
environment_hints: Use historically relevant locations, maps as unlabeled shapes, old villages, caves, ships, tools, documents, or battlefields only when the narration supports them; no invented labels or modern props in ancient scenes.
action_directions: wide story shot: the main stickman points toward the historically relevant location
reaction pose: the main stickman recoils with both arms raised at a surprising event
decision beat: the main stickman confidently chooses between two historically relevant objects
consequence scene: a small group of stickmen panic, argue, flee, or cooperate around one clear event
investigation pose: the main stickman crouches and examines a clue or artifact
danger beat: the main stickman runs, hides, or braces against a clear threat
visual twist: the main stickman gives a suspicious side-eye or smug shrug
environment action: the main stickman moves through a village, ship, cave, street, or battlefield fitting the script
negative_prompt: photograph, photorealism, realistic human anatomy, live action, 3D, CGI, glossy toy, anime, chibi, glowing eyes, superhero armor, overdesigned concept art, realistic skin, bokeh, garbled writing, captions, typography, logo, watermark, duplicate main character, extra limbs, deformed hands, blurry subject, static lineup
